label: Overleaf
title: Overleaf
subtitle: Connects to an Overleaf project and lets agents clone it locally, pull the latest changes, push edits back, and review diffs. Useful for collaborative writing workflows between InnoviumAI and Overleaf.
whenToUse: Use when you have a paper or report in Overleaf and want an agent to read, edit, or contribute to it.

methods.name: Clone Overleaf Project
methods.description: Clones an Overleaf project to the local project folder using git credentials.

methods.name: Pull from Overleaf
methods.description: Fetches and merges the latest changes from Overleaf.

methods.name: Push to Overleaf
methods.description: Commits local changes and pushes them to Overleaf.

methods.name: Check Status
methods.description: Shows which files have been modified locally since the last sync.

methods.name: Show Diff
methods.description: Returns a diff of local changes against the last pulled version.

mediaCaption: An Overleaf Push action card confirming the files committed and pushed, with the Overleaf project URL
tips: Always Pull before making changes to avoid merge conflicts.
Use Show Diff before Push to review what the agent has changed.
